annotations.title: Open a vote for the pass holders of an event (hosts and organizers only)

description: Opens a vote for the people who added the event pass. Needs the event, a question and the options, as many as you name; the only limit is technical. One vote per pass, changeable until the vote closes, secret: counts only, never who. Without confirm it returns the number of passes and the exact line and sends nothing; with confirm true it opens the vote and puts the line on every event pass without an alert. quiet false sends an alert, only when the host asks; for a vote already open without one, call again with the event, the question and quiet false. An alert counts against the notice limits: six an hour per event and Google's alerts per pass per day. Always call once without confirm and read the preview to the person; set confirm true only on the call after they say yes.

confirm.description: Absent previews; true opens the vote.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

options.description: The options, one plain line each, as many as you name. At least two to open a vote.

question.description: One plain line. No links or markup. Optional only with quiet false for a vote already open.

quiet.description: Default true: no alert. False sends an alert; only when the host asks.

requestId.description: Optional caller id; one id opens once.
